depends_on: P1 does not need to be scientifically positive, but at least one reproducible executor path and verifier-first task path must be operational before P2 execution
No P2 execution may use the sealed P1 holdout by default
research_question: For software-engineering tasks resumed after an externally imposed checkpoint, does transferred task continuity state improve verified completion efficiency compared with workspace-only or trajectory-based baselines after all handoff/context overhead is counted?
null_hypotheses: Workspace-only resumption is at least as efficient as structured task-state transfer.
Existing compression/summary methods are at least as efficient as a DV-specific structured task state.

design.stage_A: same-executor fresh-instance resumption to isolate continuity from executor mismatch
design.stage_B: cross-executor handoff only if stage_A shows exploitable continuity headroom
design.stage_C: handoff direction/timing only if stage_B remains justified
design.checkpoint_policy: externally imposed and frozen before treatment execution; initial default target is 50% of execution budget or an equivalent objective milestone if budget checkpointing is impossible

initial_treatments.C0_WORKSPACE_ONLY: Successor receives the same workspace/world state and task statement, with no predecessor trajectory or custom task-state package.
initial_treatments.C1_FULL_TRAJECTORY: Successor receives workspace plus full transferable predecessor trajectory subject to safety/redaction limits.
initial_treatments.C2_EXISTING_COMPRESSION: Successor receives workspace plus a frozen existing summary/compression method; no DV-specific intelligent compiler.
initial_treatments.C3_FIXED_STRUCTURED_STATE: Successor receives workspace plus a deterministic fixed schema of task knowledge; no full trajectory.
initial_treatments.C4_STRUCTURED_STATE_PLUS_RECENT: Successor receives workspace plus fixed structured task knowledge and a frozen bounded recent interaction window.

deferred_treatment: Adaptive executor-specific context compilation is prohibited in initial P2. It may be proposed only if simpler structured continuity is supported and a measurable residual headroom remains.
secondary_metrics: total monetary cost / verified solved task
successor recovery tokens until first new verified progress
accounting_rule: All predecessor, checkpointing, serialization, compression, summary, handoff, successor bootstrap, verification, retry, and controller costs relevant to a treatment are included. UNMEASURED != ZERO.
anti_bias_rules: STRUCTURED_STATE is not assumed superior to existing compression
No adaptive context compiler may be introduced to rescue a losing fixed-state treatment
No treatment definition may change after outcome observation
architecture_effect: NONE until decision-gate requirements are met
holdout: SEPARATE_OR_FUTURE; P1 sealed holdout remains untouched by default
